title: Google\Cloud\WebRisk\V1\SearchHashesRequest
name: SearchHashesRequest
description: Request to return full hashes matched by the provided hash prefixes.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.hash_prefix
params.description: A hash prefix, consisting of the most significant 4-32 bytes of a SHA256 hash. For JSON requests, this field is base64-encoded.

params.name: data.threat_types
params.description: Required. The ThreatLists to search in. Multiple ThreatLists may be specified.

methods.name: getHashPrefix
methods.description: A hash prefix, consisting of the most significant 4-32 bytes of a SHA256 hash. For JSON requests, this field is base64-encoded.

methods.name: setHashPrefix
methods.description: A hash prefix, consisting of the most significant 4-32 bytes of a SHA256 hash. For JSON requests, this field is base64-encoded.

methods.name: getThreatTypes
methods.description: Required. The ThreatLists to search in. Multiple ThreatLists may be specified.

methods.name: setThreatTypes
methods.description: Required. The ThreatLists to search in. Multiple ThreatLists may be specified.
